import pandas as pd

source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_74/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_74/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_74/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_74/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_74/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_74_4 with Source5_74_0 on Prod_id
df = pd.merge(source4, source0, how='inner', left_on='Prod_id', right_on='Prod_id')

# Join the result with Source5_74_1 on Ord_id
df = pd.merge(df, source1, how='inner', left_on='Ord_id', right_on='Ord_id')

# Join the result with Source5_74_2 on Cust_id
df = pd.merge(df, source2, how='inner', left_on='Cust_id', right_on='Cust_id')

# Join the result with Source5_74_3 on Ship_id
df = pd.merge(df, source3, how='inner', left_on='Ship_id', right_on='Ship_id')

# Aggregate sum of Profit (no group by since target schema has only Profit column)
result = pd.DataFrame()
result['Profit'] = [df['Profit'].sum()]

# Write output to the target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_74/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
